Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical misinterpretation of the biological function of Antidiuretic Hormone (ADH). The term "antidiuretic" literally means "against urine production." The Planner incorrectly reasoned that ADH "flushes excess water out" and "increases urine production," which is the exact opposite of its actual physiological role. In reality, ADH acts on the kidneys to increase water reabsorption, thereby reducing urine output (urinating less) to conserve water, while simultaneously stimulating thirst. This fundamental error in understanding the definition and mechanism of the hormone led to the selection of the wrong answer (A) instead of the correct one (B).
